scope: Final focused validation of tool/runtime error classification and related EL-TK-061 behavior after the final freeze. No canonical corpus regeneration, physical-result edits, or broad media rerun.

checks.details: Four existing truncated/corrupt media samples were rejected. Two were classified INVALID_OR_UNSUPPORTED_INPUT and two VALIDATION_REJECT; each had zero outputs and an unchanged original.

Output I/O failure produced PROCESSING_FAILED / OUTPUT_OR_RUNTIME_IO / OUTPUT_TRANSFORM; the harness confirmed the thumbnail existed before the injected output-open failure and exported no partial output. Cancellation stopped a running child with a private partial file and exported nothing. Timeout was classified RESOURCE_OR_PROCESS_FAILURE. Originals remained unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Invalid/corrupt inputs are rejected without being confused with runtime/output I/O failures.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: 4/4 targeted negative revalidations; 17/17 focused tests include missing-tool, permission, output-I/O, recognized decoder-rejection, and fail-closed unknown-exit checks.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Processing failures, cancellation, and timeout do not publish partial outputs or mutate originals.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: 3/3 isolated fault checks passed; each confirmed zero promoted outputs and unchanged original.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The existing supplemental media evidence remains consistent with recorded inputs and outputs.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Prior 32 case/boundary attempts and 41 recorded outputs were independently checked for input immutability and output existence/checksum consistency; no mismatch was found. The final rerun was intentionally limited to targeted classification checks.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Physical browser/device compatibility is demonstrated for supported cases.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Manual matrix remains 39 PASS, 9 BLOCKED, 0 FAIL; no new physical-device results were supplied or fabricated.

relatedExistingEvidence.postgresMinioIntegration: 9/9 recorded integration checks passed in the existing supplemental evidence; not rerun in this focused validation.

limitations: Physical playback, format compatibility, and device/browser behavior remain unverified for the 9 blocked manual rows.
The 40 MP limit is an experimental inspection bound and does not establish performance at that size.
HEIF evidence covers the recorded HEVC 8/10-bit and mif1 samples only; it does not establish universal profile/plugin compatibility.
Prior PostgreSQL/MinIO integration evidence was inspected but not rerun in this focused pass.
No validation gate or overall experiment is marked PASS.
